white_minus_black.design: stratified patient-cluster bootstrap: patients resampled within each subgroup independently; disjoint groups, not a paired comparison

transfer_band.delta_definition: next admittime minus index dischtime, exact timestamps, in fractional days
transfer_band.rationale: a subsequent record beginning at or within 48 hours before the index discharge timestamp reflects inter-unit transfer or administrative re-registration, not a community return; no records fall below the -2-day bound in this cohort
